rules.rows: every row has exactly cell.w characters (no trimming)
rules.keys: per sprite: character -> palette entry 'ramp.index' (actor/ui/terrain groups); player layers use the rig keys so recolor groups apply
rules.recolor: player layers: replace ramps skin/hair/tunic/cloak with a palette 'recolor' set (skin s1-s6, hair x6, dye x6 for tunic and cloak)
